author: chloe
text: Rollout control v1 for Atlas in Figma: slider from 0–100% of eligible workspaces + allowlist + big red kill switch. Main question: should the slider snap to 1/5/10/25/50/100?

author: leo
text: Snapping is good for a11y too; arbitrary values on a slider are miserable with a keyboard. Please make sure the kill switch isn't next to the slider in tab order.

author: priya
text: Snap points yes. And I want the default state to be 0% + allowlist only. Widening should always be a deliberate act.

author: omar
text: From the design partner interviews: Northwind's ops leads said 'I need to know who has it on'. Showing the allowlist of workspaces right in the control would help.

author: chloe
text: Final rollout control: snap points 1/5/10/25/50/100, allowlist table with workspace names, kill switch in its own section with a typed confirmation. Sam is building it in #219.

author: leo
text: One more: the slider needs `aria-valuetext` like '10 percent of eligible workspaces', not just '10'.
